Name: Simple Foliage - East Scarp Remastered
Author: MidnightVoyager
Description:
Do you use Simple Foliage? Do you use East Scarp Reimagined? Do you want the foliage from East Scarp to match Simple Foliage? I got you covered. The mod also detects VPR, Earthy, and Starblue and will color the foliage accordingly. The VPR plum tree color will also match the East Scarp VPR update that I did over on the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]Vibrant Pastoral Reborn[/url] page, so the fall version will be orange.

This is a content patcher mod, so you don't have to worry about the file being overwritten by updates!

1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
2. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787]East Scarp 3.0[/url] and its requirements.
3. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8164]Simple Foliage[/url].
4. Install this mod.

[b]THANKS:[/b]
Lemurkat for East Scarp!
Itsanette for Simple Foliage!
